_comment: This file holds ONE record: general facts about the school, used across many pages (homepage, About, Academics, Contact, footer). See CONTENT-GUIDE.md for a full explanation of every field. Fields ending in _en are English text; the matching _hi field is the same information in Hindi — leave a _hi field as an empty string and the site will show the English version instead. Anything in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is a placeholder — replace the whole bracketed phrase with real information. Do not delete a field even if you don't have the information yet; just leave the placeholder text there. This _comment field itself is ignored by the website.
